## Practical 2 worked example

```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

breeding_sites <- read_csv('data/breeding_site_locations.csv')
connectivity_data <- read_csv('data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv')

gt(head(connectivity_data))
glimpse(connectivity_data)
colnames(connectivity_data)
#colnames(breeding_sites)
#glimpse(breeding_sites)
```

![](images/clipboard-1456296812.png){width="353"}

```{r}

breeding_selected <- breeding_sites |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_longitude = Longitude, Breeding_latitude = Latitude)

gt(breeding_selected)
```

```{r}

bird_migration_selected <- connectivity_data |>
  select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude, Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude, Stopover_Longitude = pslon, Stopover_Latitude = pslat, Iberian_Longitude = iblon, Iberian_Latitude = iblat, Westmost_Longitude = awestlon, Westmost_Latitude = awestlat)

gt(head(bird_migration_selected))
```

```{r}
bird_breeding_dartmoor <- breeding_selected |> filter(Site != 'Dartmoor' & Site != 'Moscow')
print(bird_breeding_dartmoor)
```

```{r}
# Fiter out spain data as no complete dataset

bird_breeding_exc <- breeding_selected |> filter(Site != 'Spain')
bird_migration_exc <- bird_migration_selected |> filter(Site != 'Spain')

gt(bird_breeding_exc)
gt(bird_migration_exc)
```

```{r}
bird_migration_grouped_test <- bird_migration_exc |> group_by(Site)

lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped_test |> 
  summarise(Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
            Lowest_Lat_Stopover = min(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
            Mean_Lat_Stopover = mean(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
            Highest_Lat_Winter = max(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
            Lowest_Lat_Winter = min(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
            Mean_Lat_Winter = mean(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE))

```

```{r}

bird_migration_summary <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(Stopover_Latitude = median(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm=TRUE),
            Stopover_Longitude = median(Stopover_Longitude, na.rm=TRUE),
            Iberian_Longitude = median(Iberian_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
            Iberian_Latitude = median(Iberian_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
            Westmost_Longitude = median(Westmost_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
            Westmost_Latitude = median(Westmost_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
            Winter_Longitude = median(Winter_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
            Winter_Latitude = median(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
bird_migration_grouped <- bird_migration_exc |> group_by(Site)



bird_migration_summary <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(across(Winter_Longitude:Westmost_Latitude, ~ median(.x, na.rm=TRUE)))

# ~ median(.x, na.rm=TRUE) is a purr lambda function. the .x represents the input columns.

gt(bird_migration_summary)
```

```{r}
bird_breeding_exc <- bird_breeding_exc |> rename(Breeding_Longitude = Breeding_longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Breeding_latitude)

joined_migration_breeding_data <- full_join(bird_breeding_exc, bird_migration_summary)

gt(joined_migration_breeding_data)
```

```{r}
combined_bird_piv <- joined_migration_breeding_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(c("_longitude", "_latitude")),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_to = c("Location_Type", ".value")
  )

gt(combined_bird_piv)
```

```{r}

spring_locations <- c('Breeding', 'Stopover', 'Winter')
autumn_locations <- c('Breeding', 'Iberian', 'Westmost', 'Winter')

spring_data <- combined_bird_piv |>
  filter(Location_Type %in% spring_locations)
autumn_data <- combined_bird_piv |>
  filter(Location_Type %in% autumn_locations)

write_csv(spring_data, 'data/spring_data.csv')
write_csv(autumn_data, 'data/autumn_data.csv')
```

```{r}

```

```{r}
longitudes <- spring_data |>
  pull(Longitude)
min_max <- c(max(longitudes), min(longitudes))

latitudes <- spring_data |>
  pull(Latitude)
min_max2 <- c(max(latitudes), min(latitudes))

borders <- c(min_max, min_max2)

print(borders)

```

```{r}

ggplot(spring_data, aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, color = Site, shape = Location_Type)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(xlim = c(borders[1] + 2, borders[2] - 2), ylim = c(borders[3] + 2, borders[4] - 2))+
  theme_minimal()+
  ggtitle('Pied Flycatcher Spring Migration Routes')+
  xlab('Longitude')+
  ylab('Latitude')+
  geom_path(aes(group = Site))
```
